final: WITH matched AS (SELECT f.rating AS rating, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM film_actor fa JOIN film f ON f.film_id = fa.film_id GROUP BY f.rating), avg_c AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM matched), kept AS (SELECT m.rating, m.cnt, a.avg_cnt FROM matched m JOIN avg_c a ON a.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL WHERE m.cnt > a.avg_cnt) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(cnt - avg_cnt) AS avg_diff FROM kept
